items.title: T. Rowe Price (NASDAQ:TROW) Misses Q2 CY2026 Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Investment management firm T. Rowe Price (NASDAQ:TROW) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 8.3% year on year to $1.91 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.57 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Launches Retail Private Markets Fund As CEO Backs Crypto Bill
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) and T. Rowe Price have partnered to launch a private markets interval fund aimed at retail investors. The new fund is designed to give individuals access to private market exposure that has typically been limited to institutions. Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon has publicly backed the revised Crypto Clarity Act, a rare break from the stance of many large bank leaders.
